title: Larry Fitzgerald Sr., longtime sportswriter, dies ...

sources.title: Larry Fitzgerald Sr., longtime sportswriter, dies ...
sources.description: Larry Fitzgerald Sr., the longtime Minnesota sportswriter and father of Hall of Fame wide receiver Larry Fitzgerald Jr., died Monday, according to his family. He was 71.
